units: meters; azimuth in degrees from +z toward +x about the head axis (x 0, z -0.012)
method: structure first. Each part is built at facet scale as units (lobes, gores, teeth) whose borders are structure lines (labels, so remesh keeps them as edges); facets lie between them. Per part: QEM to 2-3x the target, isotropic remesh at `edge` (one isotropic target: elongation along flow needs a direction-field remesh, not used) with labels preserved and clearance 0.5 mm, cleanup.tiling, then the gate on every triangle. Shells taper to a crease at free edges (no rim strips). Columns halve through transition rows where units converge (E poles), so no vertex fans out.

gate.spikes: only faces tagged hair-spike (the last 0.03-0.05 of each tip): anisotropy along the flow <= 3, each spike component <= 0.07 along it; area share reported
gate.structureLines: every selector below matches faces, and its borders survive remesh as edges
gate.flowP75: <= 20 degrees per unit for units with `flow` (meshQuality's flow option through plan-units.ts planFlowScope; triangles with aspect < 1.5 skipped, skipped share <= 0.4); radial flows leave out the disk of radius edge 8 / (2 pi) about their point (meridians converge there; the plan handles it by construction), its share reported. Gated on built units; remeshed units: flow unmeasured until a direction-field remesh
gate.loopGrid: plan units with `limits` (declared loop grids: face, head) take aspectP50 <= 2.1; all other limits unchanged

flowKinds.radial: meridian from `from` (a point, or an axis point for gores)
flowKinds.path: tangent of the unit's builder path at the nearest point (`label`)

densityRule: Each unit's density band derives from its `edge`: an equilateral tiling of edge e has 4/(sqrt(3) e^2) triangles per square meter; the band is 0.8-1.6 of that (curved and narrow regions refine). The plan check computes it; parts carry no separate band. A unit built as facets (a few triangles per tooth or pleat) carries `facetsPerUnit: [min, max]` instead: the triangle count of each of its labels stays inside it, so lowering its edge cannot pass the gate. plan-units.ts measures each unit on the model (g6-faceting gates it): `except` removes faces from a unit's selector (the gores leave out the hem band and pleats, which carry gore tags); a `pending` unit is not built yet and must match no faces; a `densityGap` records a measured miss with its numbers and reason, and the gate holds those units, and only those, outside their band.
structureLineRule: Each structureLines entry names the faces (createdBy:<label pattern> or tag:<tag>) whose borders are structure lines; the plan check asserts each matches faces and that its borders survive remesh as edges. `informational` lines are notes, not checked.
remodelAcceptance: every unit within its derived density band (densityRule); the sheet's large facets must read (B was near-smooth at 5-12k/m2, bangs and back hair most)
spikes: anisotropy along the flow <= 3 and each tagged component <= 0.07 (B: 11/18 failed, anisotropy 10-57, one 0.111 component, likely two merged tips): one component per tip
flow p75 <= 20 degrees per unit with a flow
face plane: flat facets inside tag face-plane, no fold over 20 deg, no pole or fan under the decal areas
apron bib, shoe opening and hair cap tapered too (B kept their rims), or justified here
cuff: the sheet's cuff is a thick white band; the overhang roll went with the taper, so rebuild it as a tapered band of cuff thickness
curvature field capped near each unit's edge (minEdge >= 0.8 edge) or off; structure lines decide where facets are fine
the two it.fails tests of g6-faceting.unit.test.ts become passing tests
